top_signals.title: Trump Says 'Doing Well' in Iran, Asserts Hormuz Control
top_signals.summary: US President Donald Trump said renewed attacks on Iran would likely be short-lived, reiterating his claim Washington controls the Strait of Hormuz after fresh fighting spiked energy prices and rekindled fears of an open-ended war. Bloomberg's Jon Herskovitz has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI Drama Frenzy Sends China Broadcaster Mango Soaring 64%
top_signals.summary: A frenzy for AI-generated dramas is sending investors rushing into Mango Excellent Media Co., putting the Chinese broadcaster on track to become Asia’s hottest stock this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
